ja328:1.1: Bahunnaṃ vijjati bhotī, tehi kim me bhavissati, tasmā etaṃ na socāmi piyaṃ Sammillabhāsiniṃ.
ja328:2.1: Tan tañ ce anusoceyya yaṃ yaṃ tassa na vijjati attānam anusoceyya sadā maccuvasaṃ gataṃ.
ja328:3.1: Na h' eva ṭhitaṃ nāsīnaṃ na sayānaṃ na p' addhaguṃ yāva pāti nimisati tatrāpi sarati-bbayo.
ja328:4.1: Tatth' attani vata-ppaddhe vinābhāve asaṃsaye sesaṃ sesaṃ dayitabbaṃ vītaṃ ananusocitan
